description: Pro technical audit: architecture, tech debt, opportunities and creative ideas.

diff.description: Git ref (branch, tag or SHA) — scope retrieval/analysis to files changed vs this ref.

embed.description: Enable local semantic embeddings for better retrieval.

maxTokens.description: Context budget for the assembled prompt (default: 60000, max: 200000).

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project folder (default: current directory).

promptOnly.description: Return the built context+prompt as text instead of calling an LLM — the host model (Cursor, Claude, Windsurf...) answers it directly. Default: true when no API key is configured.

name: codebase_intelligence
